jobs.description:
A few years into RevOps, most people end up choosing between staying close to admin and reporting, or moving towards building automations and the AI tools that now sit on top of the CRM. The second path is hard to get onto if you haven't done it somewhere first.

In this job you'd do both, in a commercial team that already works with AI day to day through assistants connected to Salesforce, support tickets and product data, while marketing is being rebuilt the same way. You'd build on that, starting next to the person who set most of it up and taking over the technical side from them. You'd also keep the CRM and the data underneath it in good order. That's a lot of upkeep, like permissions, data cleanup and renewal notices to thousands of customers, and there's no ops team to share it with.

Airtame makes wireless screen-sharing devices and the cloud software that manages them, used in schools and workplaces around the world. Most of our volume goes through distributors on several continents, sometimes to customers our own reps sent them. Our sales team also works deals directly, and smaller orders come through our Shopify store. Running all three through one Salesforce makes for a harder data model than most RevOps roles come with.

We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and we'd prefer you to work from the office there. Remote from elsewhere in the EU works too. You'd report to our Director of Customer Experience & Revenue Operations, who sets the roadmap with you and owns the metric definitions, and you'd work with sales, customer experience, marketing and product every week.

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)

Own the Commercial Stack: By the end of the year the technical side has moved over to you, including the AI tools the team uses. You bring the roadmap to your manager and build it, and when sales or support want a system changed, you decide how it's done.

Send the Right Renewal Message: Thousands of customers receive renewal notices. We're starting to ask customers in our cloud software how they intend to renew, and you'd build the email flows that act on it, with a separate path for each way of renewing. If a notice doesn't go out, you know within hours.

Make the Numbers Agree: Pipeline, bookings, ARR, renewals and churn come out the same in every dashboard and every AI assistant, whether the sale came through Shopify, a rep or a distributor. Your manager sets the definitions, and you make sure every system uses them.

Automate the Manual Work: Find the processes worth automating and keep shipping them, tested in a sandbox first with a way back if something goes wrong. The first one is turning the pricing claims our distributors send, in all sorts of formats, into line-item pricing in Salesforce with an audit trail. As AI assistants get better at connecting to things on their own, part of this is also deciding what's still worth building ourselves.

Bring Support onto Intercom: We're moving customer support from Zendesk to Intercom. Depending on when you join, you'd help finish the move or pick it up just after go-live, then own Intercom, including its Salesforce sync and the AI setup that gets customer feedback to the product team.

Who You Are

• You know Salesforce from the inside. A few years of hands-on admin, including Flow Builder, permissions and the data model. You write SQL and SOQL and can model data for a report yourself.

• You ask why before you build. You can tell us about a request you pushed back on, or a process you changed or dropped instead of automating it as asked, and what it was for in the first place.

• You work with AI by default. You use AI tools every day to write flows and queries, and you keep up with what's new on your own. When a new connector makes something we built unnecessary, you're happy to retire it. If you've connected tools through their APIs or written some Python or JavaScript, that's a strong plus.

• You've run a commercial system on your own. At some point you've been the only or main admin of a Salesforce org or a similar system, and you left documentation behind that someone else could take over from. Here there's no ops team behind you, so a broken sync in the morning and a dashboard request in the afternoon are both yours.

Why Airtame?

• Building on Top of Admin: You'd keep the CRM running and build automations and AI tooling on top of it, starting next to the person who set most of it up.

• Most RevOps roles are purely SaaS or purely e-commerce. Here, you get to solve the unique intellectual challenge of bridging a hardware supply chain with a high-velocity digital subscription model.

• A healthy work-life balance.

• Five weeks paid vacation and 5 days of extra paid AirtameFlex days.

• Pension and private health insurance (on FTE Copenhagen contract).

• Flexible work environment, with a hybrid mindset.

• Catered lunch in the office.

Airtame is an equal opportunity employer. We have colleagues across the globe, with both in-office and full-time remote workers. This feeds into our international hybrid mindset, with people from 25+ nationalities that make up the Airtame team.

Our work-life cultural balance is key to our success. Our team encompasses our values of trust and open communication to support each other and to collaborate in a fun and collective way.

**How We Handle Your Application Data

**Airtame ApS (CVR 35478973, Copenhagen), together with Airtame US Inc. for US roles, processes the information you submit to assess your application. We do this under the EU General Data Protection Regulation, wherever you are based. Your data is stored in Greenhouse, our recruiting system, which may store it outside the EU under standard EU safeguards. Only the people involved in hiring can see it. For roles with privileged access to our systems, we’ll contact one professional reference or previous employer that you name, to confirm your role and dates. We’ll tell you before we do. We keep your data for 6 months after the recruitment process ends, or longer where US law requires it or where you consent to us keeping it for future roles. To get a copy of your data, correct or delete it, or object to how we use it, write to data@airtame.com. You can also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet).

Build the next version of Mapon

****Mapon builds B2B SaaS for companies whose work happens in the physical world. Our platform helps businesses manage vehicles, drivers, and equipment, improve road safety, reduce costs, automate daily operations, and comply with complex transport regulations.

We started in Riga in 2006. Today, more than 35,000 clients use Mapon, with over 400,000 connected devices on the platform. We have 200+ colleagues across Europe and a network of 150+ partners worldwide. In 2025, Mapon grew revenue by 22.8% to 24.2 million EUR while remaining profitable. We have completed eight acquisitions and intend to keep growing organically and through M&A.

****Working at Mapon Denmark

****At the Mapon Danish branch, you'll join a local team of 9 colleagues. You'll have your closest teammates nearby, while also working with colleagues across our eight branches and beyond, sharing market insights and helping grow one product across different countries. It's the best of both worlds: a strong local team and a genuinely international way of working.

We're looking for an Holistic Account Manager in Denmark to grow sales within a portfolio of 200+ existing customer accounts. Your primary focus will be identifying and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Account Management is a core growth function for us.

****Your mission

****This is a sales role focused on existing customers. You'll grow your portfolio's recurring revenue by selling additional solutions and expanding customers' use of Mapon. Retaining customers and managing commercial relationships are also part of your responsibility.

You'll use CRM, revenue and product usage data to decide which customers to contact and where to invest your time. You'll lead commercial conversations and turn customer needs into sales opportunities.

Managing 200+ accounts requires structure and deliberate prioritisation. You'll combine focused work with high-potential customers with regular outreach and follow-up across the wider portfolio.

We'll teach you the product and the industry. You bring commercial drive, relationship skills and a disciplined approach to managing your work.

****The challenges you'll tackle

****Our customers operate across transport, logistics, construction, delivery, and other industries. They have different priorities, fleet sizes, and levels of experience with our products.

Some need help making better use of what they already have. Others could benefit from additional solutions or wider adoption across their business. Some may be at risk of leaving before they tell us anything is wrong.

Your challenge is to understand those differences and focus your effort where it matters most. You'll need to balance customer needs, retention risks, and growth opportunities across your portfolio.

You'll also work across internal teams to make sure customer commitments turn into action.

**What You'll Own And Do

**You'll own customer relationships, retention, and recurring revenue growth across your assigned portfolio.

• Prioritise and manage your portfolio. Use customer data to plan outreach across 200+ accounts and focus effort where the commercial impact is greatest. Develop detailed account plans for selected high-value or high-potential customers.

• Own the sales process within your portfolio. Proactively identify customer needs and recommend relevant solutions. Prepare offers, negotiate and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

• Build a pipeline from existing customers. Turn customer conversations and data into qualified opportunities. Maintain clear next steps and follow through until a decision is made.

• Build adoption and value. Help customers understand the business value of relevant Mapon solutions and identify opportunities for wider use.

• Manage retention risks. Recognise declining engagement, unresolved issues or changing requirements early. Lead the commercial response and involve the right team when specialist help is needed.

• Prepare for renewals. Start commercial conversations early, contribute to renewal planning and negotiate with long-term value in mind.

• Maintain a reliable view of your portfolio. Keep CRM records and opportunities current. Use customer and product usage data to prioritise work and forecast results.

• Coordinate internally. Work with Growth, Product, Support, Technicians and Finance to move sales opportunities forward and deliver on customer commitments. Keep ownership of commercial next steps while specialists handle their areas.

• Represent the customer internally. Share useful feedback, surface customer stories and identify opportunities for referrals.

You own the commercial relationship and sales opportunities. Our Support team handles technical questions and troubleshooting directly with customers.

Your focus is proactive sales, renewals and retention. You are not expected to serve as the technical help desk for your portfolio.

When a technical issue puts a customer relationship or sale at risk, you work with Support on the customer impact and commercial next steps. Support owns the technical investigation and resolution.

**What Success Looks Like

**

• Your portfolio's recurring revenue grows through upsell and cross-sell while losses from cancellations and reduced spending are kept under control.

• You build and close a healthy pipeline of opportunities within your existing customer base.

• You maintain consistent outreach and follow-up across your portfolio. More time goes to the strongest growth opportunities and material retention risks.

• Customer risks are identified early, with clear actions and follow-through.

• Your opportunities and forecasts are grounded in customer conversations and reliable CRM data.

• Customers understand the value of the solutions they buy and know where to get technical support.

• You contribute practical improvements to how Mapon manages and grows existing accounts.

**What We're Looking For

**You're likely to be a strong fit if you have:

• Experience in B2B account management, sales or customer success, with clear examples of closing sales and growing revenue from existing customers.

• Confidence in proactive outreach, upselling, cross-selling and negotiation.

• The ability to understand a customer's business and connect their needs with relevant solutions.

• Experience managing a large customer portfolio through segmentation, structured outreach and disciplined follow-up.

• Experience using CRM and customer data to prioritise sales opportunities and identify retention risks.

• Clear communication and the ability to build trust with customers and colleagues.

SaaS or subscription business experience is useful. So is a background in telematics, fleet management, logistics, mobility, or IoT. Neither is required—we're ready to help you learn the industry and our products.

**How You Operate

**

• You take ownership. You follow through on commitments and keep people informed.

• You are commercially curious. You want to understand how customers work, what they value and where growth can come from.

• You initiate sales conversations. You actively create opportunities within your portfolio and are comfortable asking for the business.

• You act early. You reach out before a renewal becomes urgent or a customer issue escalates.

• You prioritise deliberately. You use data and commercial judgement to decide where your time will have the greatest impact.

• You communicate honestly. You raise difficult issues, set realistic expectations and address problems directly.

• You work across teams. You involve the right specialists and stay accountable for commercial progress.

**Compensation

**A competitive, stable base salary plus an uncapped performance bonus. Every bit of new monthly recurring revenue you close through upselling and cross-selling flows straight into your bonus, so your earnings grow with your results. There's no ceiling.

We'll walk you through the full bonus structure, targets and payout schedule during the recruitment process.

**Additionally We Offer

**Join an international team of 200+ colleagues with global reach and local soul.

Partly subsided lunch at the office.

♀ Hybrid work setup – work from home or in a cozy office in Galten (mainly work is organized from the office).

Access to paid AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others when useful for your work.

Social events, team buildings, and a supportive work culture.

Laptop, accessories, and everything you need.

Extra day off on your birthday.

Annual training budget.

Flexible hours to enjoy life outside work.

Health Days— take time off when you're not feeling well, without the need for a sick leave certificate;

Referral bonus — receive a reward when you refer a candidate who successfully joins our team;

Join a friendly, supportive team where you'll thrive, with a well-planned onboarding process starting from day one to ensure your success.

****Hiring process

• CV review – Your application will be reviewed by HR and the Hiring Manager (Head of Holistic Accounts Management).

• Pre-recorded interview (Testlify) – Selected candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded interview via Testlify (in video format) to answer questions and test language knowledge, allowing you to answer at a time that suits you best.

• Online interview – interview with the Hiring Manager and HR (up to 60min).

• Background check - References from previous employers.

If you enjoy building long-term customer relationships and taking responsibility for their commercial growth, we'd like to hear from you.

This is your chance to be part of something meaningful, grow your skills, and make your mark in a dynamic and future-focused company. ****Apply now and let's shape the future of telematics – together.

• We provide detailed feedback on interview performance and/or the technical task only to candidates who have reached the final stage of the selection process.

Job Description

Would you like to work with financial regulation and compliance while contributing to the development of a growing regulatory services business at Netcompany Banking Services?

As a Business Consultant, you will work with compliance and risk management while supporting legal and governance matters for financial institutions. You will combine your regulatory expertise with an analytical and structured approach to help our customers navigate complex regulatory requirements and strengthen their compliance and risk frameworks.

We are currently expanding our regulatory services offering, where you will play an important role in delivering and further developing our services to financial institutions. Our services within the compliance and risk areas cover the regulatory process from monitoring legislation and assessing compliance risks to annual planning, data-supported compliance reviews and regulatory reporting.

We focus on the use of automation and new technologies to develop efficient and scalable regulatory services. Working closely with colleagues across data and technology, you will contribute to high-quality customer deliveries and the continued development of regulatory Services.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

As a Business Consultant, you will support the Head of Regulatory Banking Services in delivering high-quality regulatory services to financial institutions. You will contribute to daily customer deliveries while helping to develop and standardise processes, control frameworks and reporting models.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• 
Prepare and maintain compliance risk assessments and annual compliance plans for financial clients.

• 
Develop control frameworks, control questions and supporting documentation, including reviewing and quality-assuring data and control results.

• 
Prepare compliance review reports, quarterly and annual reports, and follow up on identified risks, observations and recommendations.

• 
Monitor and assess relevant financial regulation and contribute to translating regulatory requirements into control activities, policies, procedures and governance documentation.

• 
Contribute to the development of regulatory services, including supporting risk management activities and collaborating with data and technology specialists to improve and automate processes.

About you

We imagine that you have:

• 
A relevant academic degree, such as law, business law or a related field, combined with around 2–5 years of experience in compliance, financial regulation or similar areas.

• 
Solid knowledge of financial regulation and preferably experience from a compliance function within a financial institution, ideally in the second line of defence.

• 
Practical experience with regulatory risk assessments, control frameworks, documentation and compliance reporting. Experience with risk management is an advantage.

• 
Strong analytical and communication skills, a structured approach to your work and an interest in data, technology and the digitalisation of regulatory processes.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must. Your day-to-day working environment will, however, primarily be Danish-speaking.

Join an inclusive community

We highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Do you enjoy hands-on, on-site installations and working closely with customers across borders? Are you motivated by coordination, problem-solving, and seeing projects come to life in the field?

Trackman continues to grow as we develop and deliver market-leading sports tracking solutions. We are now looking for an experienced and motivated Field Operations Specialist to join our Trackman Range team and help deliver high-quality installations across the EMEA region.

On-site Trackman Range Installations and Maintenance (Up to 75%)

• 
Coordinate and execute on-site installation and maintenance of Trackman Range systems

• 
Perform precise mapping of bays, targets, tees, and safety borders using a total station

• 
Calibrate systems including tracking units, bay mapping, targets, and launch areas

• 
Set up and configure Wi-Fi access points across the range

• 
Install and configure Android touch screens

• 
Perform QA on installations and maintenance tasks to ensure system performance and stability

• 
Train customers on the use of core Trackman Range features

Planning & Preparation of Driving Range Installations (15-20%)

• 
Prepare and configure new installation equipment prior to shipment to ensure site readiness

• 
Prepare and configure replacement equipment for shipment to support maintenance and issue resolution

• 
Share field observations and insights with the Field Operations Manager for escalation to R&D

• 
Provide clear, timely feedback to Project Managers to support effective planning and smooth execution

Admin Work (5–10%)

• 
Book travel and accommodation in line with company guidelines and install schedules

• 
Submit expense reports for on-site travel on time

What Are We Looking For?

• 
Ability to travel internationally up to 75%, including potential night and weekend availability

• 
Valid driver’s license and be comfortable driving internationally

• 
Hands-on and confident working with tools and power tools in an installation environment

• 
Proven experience with project coordination and on-site installations

• 
Passion for golf and an understanding of how golfers use a driving range

• 
Strong organization, planning, and problem-solving skills

• 
Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively within a team

• 
Strong communication skills in written and spoken English

• 
Basic experience with IT infrastructure, including network setup and Wi-Fi access points

• 
Passion, drive, strong work ethic, and ability to take initiative without direct supervision

Please note: This is a full-time, fixed-term position for six months, with the possibility of extension subject to mutual agreement.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

A property manager can handle 600 tenants. That's the industry limit. Why? Because the work scales linearly: matching bank transactions to invoices, chasing late payments, answering tenant questions, coordinating repairs, preparing legal notices, renewing leases. More tenants, more of the same manual work.

With AI, that limit disappears. And both landlords and tenants get a better experience.

**About Rumli

**Eight years in property operations. ~1,000 customers across Denmark, the Netherlands, and Germany. We know this industry: the workflows, the pain points, the regulations.

Now we're making a big move: becoming a property manager. Tenant communication, bookkeeping, coordinating repairs. We handle it all. A landlord shouldn't chase late payments or find a plumber at 10 pm. We do it for them.

We're building an entirely new platform to power this. AI-native from day one. Profitable, real customers, expanding across the Nordics.

**Why this is interesting

**Property management is a great domain for a product engineer. Thousands of similar transactions, pattern-based decisions, templated documents. And 1,000 customers who will tell you exactly where it hurts. Years of domain knowledge, ready to turn into a product.

We ship with AI agents built into the workflow. Our codebase has custom skills to improve our workflow. AI writes a lot of the code; we review it. That means the slow part of building isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what to build. That's what this role is about.

**The role

**You are autonomous and independent, working with the team to solve property managers' pains and make them as efficient as possible.

• Talk to customers and property managers. Find out what actually slows them down

• Decide what to build, then build it. Mockup, prototype, ship, measure, repeat

• Own features end-to-end. Database to API to UI

• Build AI into core product features

• Work directly with our co-founder on product direction

We need someone who looks at a messy problem and figures out what to build, and doesn't wait for a spec.

**Tech stack

**TypeScript everywhere. But does it even matter anymore?

• Frontend: Next.js, React, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS

• Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

• Infra: AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, EventBridge, SQS

**What We're Looking For

**

• Product thinking. You understand what it takes to build a profitable product. You are not here just to handle tickets.

• Strong product mindset. Agents can code, but they need scoping and steering.

• You've shipped things people actually use, and you can show them.

• Comfortable talking to customers.

• Experience with coding agents.

• Work independently.

• Copenhagen-based (on-site).

Big plus: AWS, AI experience (prompt engineering, RAG, agents), fintech/proptech background, a side project you're proud of.

**Compensation & Benefits

**

• Compensation: 50–65K DKK, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies

• Equity: Employee warrants offering real ownership in the company

• Workspace: Centrally located Copenhagen office

• Perks: Daily lunch included

**Why Rumli?

**Real customers. Brand-new codebase. Small team where your decisions matter.

We're rebuilding from the ground up with AI as the foundation. If you want to decide what property software should do, not just build what someone else specified, reach out.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Portfolio Analysis is where investment professionals turn data into insight on portfolios, performance and risk. Our products are business critical and widely used, so they need to keep evolving in a responsible way. Right now that means strong maintainability, high system performance, mature CI/CD, and reshaping parts of SimCorp Dimension for the cloud.

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Product Division, you will join an agile team of 5–7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. You will mainly work on backend components, APIs and services, using C#, .NET, Dyalog APL and Oracle.

AI is part of how we work every day. We see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work and build better software.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Understand and challenge customer requirements together with your team, then design, implement, test and support the chosen solutions

• Design, develop and maintain backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET, and work with Dyalog APL where it is part of the product

• Contribute to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value

• Improve performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience

• Take ownership beyond code: contribute to design discussions and help the team make sound technical decisions

• Use CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work

• Use AI every day in practical engineering work, such as exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, prototyping, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks

• Help the team discover where AI creates real value and where traditional engineering judgment should lead

• Collaborate with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software

**What We Value

**How you gained your skills matters less than your ability to learn, collaborate and take ownership. We expect you to know some of the following and to be interested in learning the rest:

• C# and .NET development, backend development and API design

• Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications

• Continuous integration and delivery, automated testing and practical quality engineering

• Relational databases, preferably Oracle or similar

• Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services

• Willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL

• Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and daily use of modern tools

• Experience with financial instruments or investment systems is an advantage but not a requirement. We will bring you up to speed through training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

We also value people who take ownership and deliver results. We look for engineers who try new approaches, work with others to leverage everyone’s strengths, and balance technical quality with business value. We want you to help build an inclusive, trust-based engineering culture.

**Benefits

**

• Global hybrid work policy – We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. You can work remotely the other days if you choose.

• Growth and innovation – Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements.

• Self-direction – Teams and developers have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

• Modern engineering in a real product context – You will work on cloud modernization, AI-enabled development and performance in large-scale financial software.

• Inclusive and diverse company culture – We want people to bring different perspectives and contribute to a respectful workplace.

• Work-life balance – We believe balance between professional and private life makes us better colleagues and better engineers.

• Empowerment – All voices are valuable, and you will be involved in shaping our work processes.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**We are 3,000 colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experience, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and skills are integrated into our everyday work.

Join our Sitaware Extensions Program and help deliver customised integrations and extensions to Systematic's defence product suite, from sensor interfaces to radio drivers. As Senior Software Developer, you will combine software design, implementation and testing in a close-knit team working in an exciting domain.

The job

You will contribute to the delivery of high-quality integrations and extensions, from requirements analysis through software design, implementation and testing. Beyond hands-on development, you will help apply and improve our development process, and share your knowledge to support the team's growth.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Designing, implementing, documenting and debugging features, working primarily on back-end development (Java) and occasionally on front-end development (Angular)

• Analysing requirements, breaking them into technical tasks, and clarifying acceptance criteria

• Implementing and troubleshooting interfaces to hardware and external systems, such as sensors and radio interfaces

• Developing and maintaining unit and integration tests, and designing for testability

• Identifying issues and recommending improvements to code, tooling, pipelines and processes

Joining the team

You will be part of the Product Extension Team of around seven developers, test engineers and architects, part of the Sitaware Extensions Program within Defence Services. The team delivers customised integrations and extensions to Systematic's defence product suite, focusing on software- and hardware-related integrations such as sensor interfaces, radio drivers and interoperability with external systems, and continuously improves its own testing and development practices, methods and tools. This is a newly created position, so you will have real scope to shape how the role develops as the team continues to grow.

Your Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring several years of software development experience gained in a structured, team-based environment, along with:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Technology or similar

What you will actually work on

Anthill Cloud is the shared platform layer behind our products. It handles identity, tenancy, content and the services that belong across the suite rather than inside any one product. Most of the interesting backend work at Anthill over the next two years sits on that line: deciding what belongs to a product, what belongs to the platform, and how to move something from one to the other without breaking a client who is mid-campaign.

Coding agents write a growing share of that code, which moves most of the engineering to the work around it: shaping the solution, running spikes before anyone commits to an approach, building the harness agents work inside, orchestrating the work, and judging what comes back. You still write the code yourself when that is the better way.

In your first year you will:

• Shape solutions before they are built: service boundaries, contracts and data models, written down as decision records in the repo that people and agents build from.

• Build the harness our agents work inside: the specs, agent instructions, tests and checks that keep generated code inside the architecture, and tighten it when something gets through.

The levels

We are hiring at mid or senior level and will fit the role to the person we meet. The kind of work is the same at both. What changes is scope. A mid owns features and the design inside them, and works well inside service boundaries and agent setups that someone else defined. A senior owns decisions that outlast the mission they were made in, and other engineers and agents build on them. Tell us where you think you sit, and we will tell you if we see it differently. • JavaScript, TypeScript and Node you can write well yourself, without an agent.

• Infrastructure as code. We use Terraform.

• API design for consumers you do not control, and the discipline that comes with not being able to change them at will.

How we work

Engineers belong to a chapter and work in missions. The chapter is your professional home and where your craft is developed.

Missions are time boxed, cross functional teams pointed at one outcome. When a round of missions closes, people rotate and a new set forms. The rotation is the point. Over a couple of years you work with most of the engineering team and across most of the product surface, instead of spending three years in one squad on one corner of the codebase.

Product decisions run through HIVE, our gate model. Nothing gets built because someone senior liked the idea. Initiatives pass through evidence, solution framing and a funding decision before engineering starts, and they are not closed until the outcome is validated rather than when the code ships. As an engineer this means you get told why something is being built, and you are expected to argue if the reasoning is thin.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You will be part of a research environment focusing on plant-microbe interactions. • A PhD in plant-microbe interactions or similar
• Collaborative skills and ability to demonstrate commitment in teams. A fondness of taking the initiative and the motivation to pursue a scientific career
• Documented experience in scientific writing and publication in peer-reviewed scientific journals
• Research experience in areas of microbial ecology and plant biology

• Teaching and supervision experience at the BSc and MSc level
• Interest and experience in developing competitive national and international research applications

• Universal healthcare for you and your family as residents.

• Generous parental leave – up to 52 weeks shared between parents, with full or partial salary.
Place of Work
The place of work is Aarhus University, Campus Flakkebjerg. The affiliation will be with the Department of Agroecology.
